pages.title: Vacuum Energy Storage
pages.text: $(thing)Vacuum Energy Storage$()$(br2)Store energy in the difference between two vacua. Unlocks the Energy Cells.

$(thing)Insight$(): 15$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Casimir Effect, Cryogenics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Casimir Plate.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Two parallel conducting plates of area A are let go at a wide gap b and allowed to drift together to a narrow gap a. Between them fewer vacuum modes fit than outside, so the vacuum pushes them together with a pressure that grows as the inverse fourth power of the gap x. Write the energy harvested as the work done by that pressure over the approach.
